title: Stephen McWilliams Joins Meridian as Regional Commercial Banking Director
summary: The post Stephen McWilliams Joins Meridian as Regional Commercial Banking Director appeared first on Meridian Bank Investor Relations .
body_markdown:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
Contact: Christopher J. Annas


484.568.5001
CAnnas@meridianbanker.com


Malvern, Pa. (April 14, 2025) – Meridian Bank announced the appointment of Stephen McWilliams to the position of Regional Commercial Banking Director for Philadelphia and South Jersey.


With over 35 years of experience in the banking industry, McWilliams has specialized in business lending to a variety of industries, credit risk management and team building. In this new role, McWilliams will strengthen the Meridian brand, cultivate relationships in South Jersey, and expand our market share in Philadelphia.


Prior to joining Meridian, McWilliams served as Chief Lending Officer at Republic Bank where he managed multiple commercial lending teams in Philadelphia and South Jersey encompassing a nearly $3B loan portfolio. McWilliams’ commercial banking career began with CoreStates Bank/First Union, followed by PNC, and leadership roles at Commerce Bank, TD Bank and Republic Bank.


“We’re thrilled to welcome Steve to Meridian to further expand our presence in the market. Steve is a great addition to our Commercial Lending Team because his success in working with entrepreneurs and innovative businesses so closely matches our own experience,” said Meridian Founder, Chairman and CEO Chris Annas.


McWilliams is a lifelong Philadelphian, born and raised in Upper Darby. He has also contributed to the community with his leadership on the Corporate Executive Board of the Philadelphia Museum of Art, the Main Line Chamber of Commerce and John Hallahan High School, as well as serving the Montgomery Township Police Pension Fund. Steve obtained his undergraduate degree from West Chester University and a Master’s degree from Drexel University.


**About Meridian Corporation**
Meridian Bank, the wholly owned subsidiary of Meridian Corporation (Nasdaq: MRBK), serves Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, Maryland and Florida through a network of bank branches, mortgage and wealth management offices. Offering a full suite of financial products and services, Meridian specializes in business and industrial lending, retail and commercial real estate lending, electronic payments and wealth management solutions, along with a menu of high-yield depository products, all supported by robust online and mobile access. For additional information, visit[www.meridianbanker.com](https://www.meridianbanker.com/) . Member FDIC. Equal Housing Lender.
